title: Anu Disebutkeun di Kulawarga Nabi
intro: Di kulawarga utusan pamungkas, aya hiji jiwa anu carita pribadina janten palajaran ilahi pikeun sadaya anu percaya. Kahirupan tokoh ieu raket patalina sareng paréntah transformatif anu ngarobih adat istiadat sosial salamina, nandakeun parobahan anu ageung dina kumaha iman bakal ngahartikeun kulawarga sareng kagolong.
clues: Nami abdi baheula aya patalina sareng garis keturunan anu mulya, tapi bebeneran anu langkung luhur engkéna bakal ngajelaskeun beungkeutan iman anu sajati.
Abdi nampi ni'mat anu ageung ti Allah sareng Rasul-Na, hiji ni'mat anu parantos diumumkeun sacara umum dina Kitab Suci.
Kahirupan rumah tangga kuring jadi ujian penting anu bakal ngarobah persepsi ngeunaan hubungan anu diadopsi salamina.
Abdi teh jalmi anu cocoba pribadina ngarah kana paréntah ilahi anu ngamungkinkeun Nabi nikah ka saurang awéwé saatos abdi angkat.
Ngaliwatan carita kuring, bédana antara kulawarga biologis sareng kulawarga pilihan dijelaskeun pikeun sadaya generasi.
Di antara babaturan kuring, kuring hiji-hijina anu ngaranna disebutkeun sacara éksplisit dina wahyu anu terakhir, lain salaku nabi, tapi salaku hamba anu diuji sareng dihormat.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
